landing.title: Get your CV job-ready with AI
landing.subtitle: Upload your PDF CV, see how well you fit a job posting, and download an ATS-ready CV in one click.
landing.step1Body: Drop your PDF; AI parses and structures it in seconds.
landing.step2Body: Paste a posting link; see your strengths and gaps clearly.
landing.step3Body: Download a clean PDF that applicant-tracking systems can read, in one click.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
auth.checkEmail: Check your email for the confirmation link.

dashboard.title: My CVs
dashboard.empty: No CVs yet. Upload your PDF CV to get started.
dashboard.deleteConfirm: Delete this CV? This cannot be undone.

score.title: Fit Score
score.urlHint: Paste the link to the page where the job posting itself opens; search-result or listing-page links will not work.
score.pasteFallbackNotice: Could not fetch the posting page. Please paste the job text below.
score.cached: Showing the previous result for this CV and posting.

ats.title: Convert to ATS
ats.intro: Pick a CV and a language; you get a clean, ATS-readable PDF. The copy is also saved to your dashboard.
ats.done: Converted! The PDF was downloaded and the ATS copy was saved to your dashboard.

applications.title: My applications
applications.intro: Connect Gmail and see every company's reply in one place.
applications.connectExplain: We only read application emails — we never send or delete anything, and we don't download your personal correspondence. Disconnect whenever you like.
applications.partial: Partially updated — we hit a Gmail limit. Try again shortly.
applications.revoked: Your Gmail connection has expired. Reconnect to continue.
applications.noEvents: We haven't seen an email for this application yet.

optimize.title: Optimize & Apply
optimize.intro: Pick a CV and paste a job application link. We tailor the CV to the posting, draft answers to the form, and let you review everything before applying.
optimize.loginIntro: This page needs you to sign in. We'll open a visible browser window — sign in there, and we continue automatically. Your password is never sent to us.
optimize.loginButton: Sign in the window and continue
optimize.loginWaiting: Waiting for sign-in in the browser window…
optimize.requiredEmpty: You need to fill this in
optimize.fileNote: Your CV will be uploaded automatically as an ATS PDF.
optimize.deliverModeNote: This page can't be submitted automatically (sign-in loop, CAPTCHA, or no form found). You can take the materials below.
optimize.resultDelivered: Ready. Your optimized CV was saved to your dashboard.
optimize.assistIntro: A browser window is open. Navigate to the application form there (choose a method, sign in, advance the steps). When the form is on screen, click "Fill form".
optimize.assistUnfilled: I could not fill these — please complete them by hand:
optimize.assistReasonLoginWall: This page wants you to sign in. Log in in the browser and try again.
optimize.assistReasonCaptcha: This page has a captcha. Clear it and try again.
optimize.assistReasonNoControls: I found no fillable fields here. Move to the application form and try again.
optimize.assistReasonUnsupported: I could not read this page's structure.
optimize.assistReasonBlocked: This site blocked our access. The assistant cannot apply to this posting; download your optimized CV and apply by hand.
optimize.assistReasonBrowserClosed: The browser window opened for this application has closed. Press "Finish" and start the assisted application again.
optimize.assistReviewNote: Review the fields in the real browser and submit there yourself. If there's another step, click "Fill form" again.

errors.SCANNED_PDF: This PDF looks scanned. Please upload a text-based PDF.
errors.INVALID_PDF: Invalid file. Please upload a PDF.
errors.FETCH_FAILED: Could not fetch the posting page.
errors.JOB_PARSE_FAILED: Could not read the job details from that page. Please paste the text instead.
errors.NO_INPUT: Enter a posting URL or paste the job text.
errors.DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: You reached today's AI usage limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is not responding right now. Please retry shortly.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Please log in again.
errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: The browser session was closed. Start the assisted apply again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This browser session belongs to another account.
errors.TOO_MANY_SESSIONS: The server is at capacity right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.GMAIL_DISCONNECTED: The Gmail connection is no longer valid. Reconnect your email account.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
